Name: CP-Cat Achievements Icons
Author: somniumterra
Description:
It's a simple mod that changes the icons of achievement.

Two variants in the config: white/black  (default: white)

How to use:
Download Content Patcher
Unzip the file and drop it into your mods folder

Compatibility:
If the other mod didn't change the achievement star, it should be fine, otherwise, this will overwrite the other.
